issue.body:
Hi, when startup tasks are raising some exceptions, there is only "lifespan.startup.failed" message being sent to ASGI to prevent from further processing:
```
        except BaseException:
            if first:
                exc_text = traceback.format_exc()
                await send({"type": "lifespan.startup.failed", "message": exc_text})
            raise
```

Isn't better to await there shutdown to clear everything up like database connections (disconencting defined within shutdown) for instance?
```
        except BaseException:
            if first:
                exc_text = traceback.format_exc()
                await send({"type": "lifespan.startup.failed", "message": exc_text})
                await self.shutdown() # <----------------
            raise
```
issue.title: Trigger lifespan shutdown once startup fails
